samples: This module is a small deadline helper: it parses task lines into typed tasks, filters tasks due within a chosen window, and counts the working days remaining between today and each due date. Its `main` function demonstrates the behavior by checking a built-in sample list against the current date and printing the soonest deadlines with their remaining weekday count. It is useful if you want simple date-based task triage, but it is narrowly focused and only handles basic comma-separated input plus Monday-to-Friday counting.

This module is a small deadline helper: it parses task lines into typed tasks, filters tasks due between today and a chosen future cutoff, and counts how many weekdays remain until each due date. It also includes a console program that uses today’s date and prints the sample tasks that are due within the next ten days, along with their remaining working days. It’s useful if you want simple date-based task triage with weekday-aware countdowns, but it only demonstrates fixed sample data rather than reading real task lists.

This module is a small deadline helper: it parses task lines of the form “title, date,” filters tasks due between today and a chosen cutoff, and sorts them by due date. It also counts how many weekdays remain from today through each task’s due date. Its `main` function demonstrates the behavior by printing the sample tasks that are due within the next ten days, along with their remaining working days.

This module is a small deadline helper: it parses task lines into typed tasks, filters tasks due between today and a chosen horizon, and counts the working days remaining until each due date. It treats only Monday through Friday as working days and sorts upcoming tasks by due date. The included main program prints a sample report for tasks due in the next ten days, so it’s useful if you want a simple date-based reminder/reporting tool.

This module defines a small task-deadline utility: it can parse task lines, identify tasks due within a chosen window, and count the working days remaining until each due date. Its main program uses today’s date and a built-in sample list to print the tasks due in the next ten days, along with how many Monday-to-Friday days are left. It is useful if you want simple deadline filtering and weekday-based countdowns, but it only demonstrates fixed sample data rather than reading real task input.
